title: Recyclarr Settings
description: Optional settings to control the behavior of Recyclarr

git_path.title: Provide an explicit path to your git executable
git_path.description: Note that this is a path to the actual executable itself and not a directory path. If this setting is not specified, Recyclarr will attempt to find git via your PATH environment variable.

enable_ssl_certificate_validation.title: Allow SSL certificate validation for Sonarr & Radarr
enable_ssl_certificate_validation.description: If set to `false`, SSL certificates are not validated. This is useful if you are connecting to a Sonarr or Radarr instance using `https` and it is set up with self-signed certificates. Note that disabling this setting is a **security risk** and should be avoided unless you are absolutely sure what you are doing.

max_files.title: The maximum number of log files to keep
max_files.description: If there are more log files than the max allowed here, Log Janitor will remove the oldest log files.

server.title: Settings for the Recyclarr HTTP server

port.title: Port number for the HTTP server to listen on
port.description: Ignored by the Docker image, which always listens on port 7982; remap it with Docker port mapping.

bind_address.title: Address for the HTTP server to bind to
bind_address.description: Use 'localhost' to bind to the loopback interface only, or '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces. Ignored by the Docker image, which always listens on all interfaces.

schedule.title: Built-in sync schedule of the persistent server
schedule.description: Applies only to the persistent server (`recyclarr serve` or the Docker image). A scheduled sync is skipped when another sync is already running.

enabled.title: Run sync on the schedule
enabled.description: Set to false when an external scheduler creates sync jobs through the API.

cron.title: Standard 5-field cron expression for when to sync
cron.description: Evaluated in the system time zone (the TZ environment variable in containers).

resource_providers.title: Resource providers for various content types
resource_providers.description: Flat list of resource providers with explicit precedence (bottom-up: last provider wins for duplicate resources)
